name: Arcane
description: Ombre rampante se faufilant dans les recoins les plus sombres des installations ennemies pour des opérations d'espionnage.

subject.archetype: Chthonian Shadow Stalker - Primordial subterrene spy creature evolved for infiltrating dimensional rifts and harvesting intelligence from collapsed realities

loadout.armor_outfit: Organic tectonic plating composed of obsidian shards and cooled basalt carapace, interlocked with glowing magma veins running beneath the surface, asymmetrical volcanic rock scales creating natural camouflage against stone surfaces, multiple eyeless heads for 360° sensory perception
loadout.arsenal: Subterranean drilling appendages for tunnelling through dimensional barriers, corrosive shadow tentacles capable of draining life essence and extracting memories, bio-luminescent rune-marked organs for reading and recording dimensional frequencies, prehensile tail with blade-like volcanic glass protrusions

attitude.behavior: Crouched in absolute stillness within a dimensional fissure, multiple shadow tentacles anchored into the torn reality around it while surveillance tendrils extended through micro-rifts tracking all enemy movements, body coiled with predatory tension like a volcanic eruption about to occur, one massive crushing jaw slightly open revealing inner magma chamber
attitude.emotion: Cold primordial patience emanating predatory intent, ancient intelligence radiating through multiple eyeless heads sensing dimensional frequencies, territorial aggression masked by supernatural stillness, volcanic heart pulsing with dormant rage

palette_names.name: Matte Basalt Gray
palette_names.role: Tectonic plating texture, secondary body mass

palette_names.name: Magma Red-Orange
palette_names.role: Internal energy veins, glowing cracks, heart core

color_and_light.mood: Menacing, primordial dread, supernatural horror, oppressive underground tension

scenography.setting: Torn dimensional battlefield with ground splitting open in massive fissures as enormous shadow tentacles erupt from below, sky showing impossible geometry and wrongness human mind cannot process, ancient runes blazing on every surface as dimensions collapse, reality thinning and tearing at edges
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Volcanic smoke billowing from every fissure, magma rivers glowing beneath cracked ground, supernatural dread fog, dimensional energy sparks, ancient chthonian runes pulsing with dying reality energy, reality fragments floating in impossible patterns, thick oppressive atmosphere of otherworldly terror
